snippet.title: Lost Garden - Trailer
snippet.description:
LOST GARDEN
A virtual space that represents lost nature and invites users to renew their partnership experience and appreciation for nature through creation. The game provides an opportunity to sculpt a breathing system composed of soil, water, and plants. This takes place in a process of development, discovery, and progress, alongside disconnection and relaxation.

Design: Ori shany
Program: Yoni Pushett, Ramon Zerem

Guidance: Eric Lerner, Doron Assayas Terre


Final project, Visual Communication department, Bezalel Academy of Arts and Design, in collaboration with the Hebrew University of Jerusalem, 2024.
